quandoUsar: Showcase of a few image highlights (destinations, guides, projects, categories) where hovering shows the preview and pressing the open card leads to the detail.
Page sections where one item is always in the spotlight and the others appear as slices with the title.
quandoEvitar: Use `carousel` when there are many items or all need the same prominence; here, each additional card narrows the closed slices.
Use `image-viewer` to open and zoom photos.
Use `tabs` when each option reveals its own content (text, forms) instead of a short preview over an image.

teclado.acao: Move focus to the previous or next card, which opens on receiving focus; `↑` and `↓` do the same.
Go to the first and last card.
Each card is a `Tab` stop, and focus opens the card.

acessibilidade: The rail is a `role="group"` named by `label`; each card is a `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and the title in hidden text, and the preview texts enter the button's name when it opens.
Focus opens the card, so keyboard users see the same preview as the cursor; on touch, the first tap on a closed card only opens it, and the second selects it.
The image's `alt` is empty by default: fill in `alt` on the item only when the image says something the title doesn't.
movimento: Only `flex-grow` animates, on a spring with no overshoot: the open card grows to `ratio` times the width of a closed one, and the rest become slices.
The open card's image brightens, the vertical label disappears, and the preview lines rise 10 px in sequence.
With “reduced motion”, the width swaps instantly and the preview only fades.
responsivo: The root is a container: at up to 520 px the rail becomes a column, 1.5 times taller than `height`, and the open card grows vertically, with the closed cards' labels horizontal.
A closed card's width is the rail's width, minus the gaps, divided by `ratio` + number of items − 1; with many items, the slices become too narrow for the label.
desempenho: Animating `flex-grow` redoes the row's layout on every frame, so the image and preview are born at the open size and the card only reveals them; all images load immediately, without `loading="lazy"`.
notasIA: Each item needs `id`, `title`, and `image`; `eyebrow`, `description` (clamped to two lines), and `meta` are optional.

There is always one open card (the first, by default): `value` with `onValueChange` controls which, and `onSelect` fires when pressing the already open card; do the navigation in it, since the card is a button, not a link.
`trigger="press"` makes the mouse open cards only on click, not on hover (focus and touch still open them); `height` is in px, and the width comes from the parent.
